name: CookieBanner
title: CookieBanner
summary: A small charcoal card at the bottom-left of ism.bible that asks for cookie consent on the first visit, with Accept All and Reject Non-Essential.
whenToUse: Show it on the first visit to any ism.bible page, and again after the stored choice expires (365 days).
Reopen it from "Cookie settings" in the Footer legal row.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it for news, newsletter or app prompts. Use an alert, Toast or AppBanner for those.
Do not show it inside the dot.Bible app or in email.

anatomy.description: The card is the shared `.cookie` class (fixed, bottom-left, `var(--charcoal-900)`, 20px radius). Add a heading, one paragraph with a Learn more link, and two buttons. For docs and static boards add `.nv-static` (`.cookie.nv-static`) to drop fixed positioning and the rise animation.

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the banner is shown. You own this state: show it on the first visit, hide it after a choice,
show it again when the stored choice expires (365 days) or from "Cookie settings".

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called when the reader presses the accept button. Store the choice and load analytics here. The library writes no cookies.

props.name: onDecline
props.description: Called when the reader presses the reject button. Store the choice here. The library writes no cookies.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading, for example "A note on cookies".

props.name: children
props.description: The paragraph, for example "We use cookies to enhance your experience…".

props.name: learnMoreHref
props.description: URL of the Cookie Policy page. Renders the "Learn more" link when given together with `learnMoreLabel`.

props.name: learnMoreLabel
props.description: Text of the link, for example "Learn more".

props.name: acceptLabel
props.description: Label of the primary button, for example "Accept All".

props.name: declineLabel
props.description: Label of the outline button, for example "Reject Non-Essential".

props.name: static
props.description: Drop fixed positioning and the rise animation, for docs and static boards.

variantNotes: **Desktop:** fixed 24px from the bottom-left, `width:min(440px, 100vw - 32px)`, rises in over 400ms.
**Mobile (below 768px):** 16px inset; the buttons wrap and stack full width.
**After a choice:** hide the card, store the choice for 365 days, and load analytics only on Accept All.
**Reopened:** "Cookie settings" in the footer shows the same card with the current choice; the buttons act the same.
Buttons use the standard `.btn` hover and focus states.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Accept All is the one Horizon Blue primary (`.btn-primary`). Reject Non-Essential is `.btn-outline-light`, same size, never a text link, so both choices are equally easy.
Keep it bottom-left. BackToTop sits bottom-right above it (z-index 72 vs 70); they never overlap.
Never block the page with a scrim or modal. Content stays readable and scrollable.
Keep the card `var(--charcoal-900)` on every page, light or dark.
Remember the choice for 365 days; do not ask again before then unless the policy changes.
Buttons are at least 44px tall (`.btn` default).

accessibility: Use `role="region"` with `aria-labelledby` pointing to the heading, so it is listed as a landmark.
Do not steal focus on load. Place it early in the DOM after the skip link so keyboard users reach it quickly.
After a choice, move focus back to where it was (or to `main`), not to the top of the page.
Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: show it without the rise animation.
content: Body: "We use cookies to enhance your experience and analyze traffic. By clicking ‘Accept All’, you consent to our use of cookies. Learn more".
Buttons: "Accept All" and "Reject Non-Essential". Keep this exact casing.
"Learn more" goes to the Cookie Policy page.
